## The queue items — 5

### 11 · The notification listener

The step change in presence — event-driven, nearly free, and more context than any polling can buy. **Gated on the token split, which is gateway work:** a listener sees OTPs, balances and private messages, and once that is collected badly no later fix un-collects it. What can be built now is the spec and the pure drop-rule reducer, with no service registered and no permission asked.

### 12 · Split APP_TOKEN by capability

One string gates the socket, push, `/app-commute` and `/app-state` alike, and nothing expires. The gateway validates both halves, so it cannot land here. The gate in front of every new sense, not a follow-up.

### 13 · Merge fix/durable-state, then deploy

Until it merges into the gateway branch, **every deploy silently disarms the briefing** — which has already happened twice. Also carries the fix for the false Saturday shift, committed as `c86d176` and still not live.

### 14 · The situation sent to the persona

Place, battery, link — one field on the envelope. The most character per line of code available anywhere in the plan, and it is a gateway change.

### 15 · Delivered and read ticks

The phone knows *sent*. Only the gateway can say *delivered* and *read*, and it says neither. Needs a per-message id on both sides — and reply-to-a-message wants the same id, so it follows rather than inventing a second identity for a message.

## What can still be built on this side of the line

Blocked elsewhere does not mean nothing is owed here first.

- **Queue 11, the notification listener** — the spec and the pure drop-rule reducer, with tests, with no service registered and no permission asked. The gating on 12 is a privacy decision, not a sequencing one: a listener sees OTPs, balances and private messages, and once that is collected badly no later fix un-collects it.
- **Queue 20's app half** — derive facts from turns, keep a ledger of what was sent, supersede what changed, send derived facts and never raw rows. `shareFacts` is the proved shape to copy. Consent rule comes first. Only the brain half is blocked: the ask envelope carries **one turn**, so he answers cold even though `chat_turns` holds the history.
